content.title: Is Costco open or closed on Easter 2026? What to know
content.text: And just like that, another week has rolled around. If you’ve been feeling a little low-energy lately — or like your to-do list is somehow getting longer instead of shorter — you’re not alone. The good news? This week's Amazon deals are here to help, whether you're in need of a quick $10 pick-me-up or a smart household upgrade that actually saves you time and money. Case in point: a two-in-one robot vacuum and mop for just $200 (yes, really) that will make your spring cleaning a breeze, 60 bucks off this extra-large, multitalented air fryer (now $80) to make dinner time quick and easy and these gorgeous flowy pants ($29/$18) that will get plenty of wear this season.Some of these deals don’t come around very often, so it’s worth having a quick browse before the FOMO kicks in.Best Amazon deals: Top picksWhat could be better than a sleek, edge-savvy robovac and mop that practically runs and charges itself? One that comes with the added benefit of auto-emptying, of course! This clever helper stores all that dust and grime in the corresponding bin for up to 75 days of hassle-free cleaning. Bonus: It's designed to sense and avoid carpets when in mopping mode, so your throw rugs will stay dry while those surrounding hard floors glisten. 🔥 Great time to buy: This baby is currently over 56% off — a whopping $250 discount. And did we mention that it's a vacuum and a mop?!This large tumbler is on sale in a smattering of fun colors, as if to announce, "Spring has sprung!" No frills here: just a simple straw-lid design with a condensation-free body to keep your hands dry, and you can pop this bad boy right into the dishwasher when it's time to clean.🔥 Great time to buy: It's marked down to its lowest price this year.These noise-canceling headphones are currently 45% off, which is a rare discount. If you enjoy blocking out the world and immersing yourself in a playlist or podcast, these headphones may be just what you've been missing. They feature new custom modes that let you adjust noise cancellation on the fly and include Wind Block to reduce breezy environments. Plus, they offer up to 24 hours of battery life on a single charge.🔥 Great time to buy: It's marked down to its lowest price since January. This dustpan is equipped with teeth that'll dislodge swept-up clumps for you, because post-cleaning cleanup is no one's idea of a good time. What is fun, however, is the fact that this duo is marked down by over 50%.Its four rows of bristles make it ideal for indoor or outdoor sweeping, and the extendable handle (ranging from 38 to 50 inches) is a boon for anyone who'd like to avoid crouching while they clean.💰Good deal: We've seen this dynamic duo go this low a couple times in the past few months, but never lower.This balm is a top seller for a reason, so seeing it marked down to just $7 is exciting. A few other shades are on sale too, but the most popular is Rum Raisin. The color looks great on everyone and keeps lips hydrated. Revlon's formula now features nourishing hyaluronic acid, aloe and even rose quartz.This floral dress is a versatile piece that can see you through seasons, thanks to its lightweight material and flattering silhouette, which features a tiered skirt, V-neckline and pockets. It can be easily dressed up or down and pairs well with knee-high boots or pumps. These running shoes are currently a bestseller while they're discounted by 35%, but this price won't last for long. They have advanced cushioning, a flexible traction outsole, and a lightweight design (7.5 oz), making these sneakers for women perfect for running, training, or casual wear.Sure, this serum's tres wallet-friendly, but don't let that fool you: It's the real deal if you want to wake up with softer skin and less noticeable lines and dark spots, fans say. As the name implies, it's packed with 10% glycolic acid, which is a resurfacing alpha-hydroxy acid that works to help reduce dark spots and wrinkles. It's suitable for daily use and free of any mineral oils, parabens, dyes and fragrances. While some glycolic acid serums can be too intense for day-to-day use, this formula also includes soothing aloe vera, which makes all the difference.It's also Eva Longoria's go-to. In an interview with Prevention, Longoria said she "can't live without the Revitalift series" and added: "For me, it smooths fine lines."Amazon's No. 1 bestselling blade was crafted with comfort in mind. Its lightweight, ergonomic Pakkawood handle is smoother than actual wood (not to mention, easier to clean) and was designed to minimize wrist stress while offering a stable grip. The 2.5-millimeter blade is made of stainless steel that's rust-, corrosion- and discoloration-resistant. One tip, though: For maximum longevity, keep it out of the dishwasher.One cool feature? Those little hollowed-out ovals lining the blade help prevent sticking, a boon when you're slicing watery onions and tomatoes. An even cooler one? This 56% discount.RHOBH star Kyle Richards gives this pack two thumbs (toes?) up. "These are great, these no-show socks. They come in a package of six!" she says during an Amazon Live. She admits that when her "socks are showing," her friends make fun of her look — "[It's] a dorky vibe," she laughs. "The aesthetic is not good, guys, if you’re wearing a sock with your workout shoes … They shouldn't show!" Now that they're nearly 50% off, we're stocking up.If want to go for the relaxed look, this style from Sidefeel is getting more popular, with tons of people jumping in on the trend over the past month. We love the cool distressed cuffs and stretchy cotton blend that makes these jeans super comfortable. "These are sooo cute. I love the stretchy material. Definitely comfortable to sit down and move around! The length is perfect as well. Very figure flattering," swooned a stylish shopper. Time to ditch the dreaded string: This gentle yet effective gum de-gunker allows you to feel the sparkle every day, thanks to its pressurized water-flossing technology. 💰Good deal: At 40% off, this is the best discount we've seen on the Aquarius since Presidents' Day. Want to start your evenings on the right foot, er, head? You'd be wise to snag this popular pair ASAP. Filled with a lofty down alternative stuffing, these plush pillows are moisture-wicking and have a cool-to-the-touch cover for a more comfortable slumber. "Very soft and cooling!" swooned a five-star fan. "Medium support, not too soft or firm. No smell. Very cozy and fluffed up beautifully! Great quality."Save $21 with extra 15% off at checkoutIf the area under your sink has become a black hole of cleaning products (along with who knows what else), these slide-out shelves are here to save the day. Because each one has two levels, you'll maximize space, making it easier to find whatever you're looking for. This is one of those items you'll wonder how you ever lived without, and with this deal, you're getting two for less than the price of a single organizer.Best Amazon deals: Rare dealsThis cooler is what happens when you take a hard cooler's toughness and durability and wrap it in a shoulder-friendly, soft-sided package. It's made from the same high-density shell Yeti uses on its toughest gear, so it'll shrug off scrapes, UV rays and whatever else your weekend throws at it. And unlike budget coolers, this one's fully welded and leakproof. I've been using mine for years.Capacity-wise, it holds 32 cans (with ice) or 15.5 pounds of straight ice or — if you're feeling classy — seven bottles of wine. The wide mouth is easy to load, and instead of a zipper, it uses strong magnets to snap shut. It seals itself like magic and has backup buckles for when things get bumpy. Right now it's nearly 35% off. Need more space? The M30 is also on sale.Want to refresh your denim for spring but not sure where to start? These flattering, versatile Levi’s straight-leg jeans are now nearly 50% off and easy to style with just about anything. Even better, they're designed with a built-in tummy panel that smooths and supports your shape.One five-star review said: "These pants are perfectly made and hug your shape in all the right places. Flattering and comfortable fit. The material is soft and weight is light medium that can be worn year round. Zipper and pockets are well made. BEST value for the perfect pair. Will buy again. HIGHLY recommended."Don't be fooled by the unassuming tube: This is one of the most-loved lipsticks of all time. While the feel of this lipstick is worthy of high praise, it's the color that makes it shine — literally. Black Honey is a deep berry shade that suits, well, everyone. No matter your skin tone, eye color, hair color or age, you can't go wrong, which is why it repeatedly sells out.💰 Good deal: We suggest grabbing this lippie while it's on a very rare sale.Get 60% off this knife set that has everything you need to feel like a pro chef in the kitchen. The anti-rust coating protects the knife from oxidation, and it is dishwasher safe. The set includes six knives, each with a blade protector for safety, as well as a pair of scissors - it's everything you need. 🔥 Great time to buy: Over 10,000 shoppers have purchased this knife set in the past month, and we bet many of them wish they'd waited for it to drop to its lowest price of the year.Best Amazon deals: Patio and outdoorsWhen it comes to bursting bugs’ bubbles, look no further than this zapper. It has a bulb that glows a bright blue hue and zaps insects that get too close. We also love that it comes with a carabiner on top, making it easy to hang from your porch, pergola, or deck. As an added bonus, it features a lantern-like design that's visually appealing. With over 19,000 five-star reviews, it's fair to say that shoppers find it effective. One customer said: "This thing is the BEST purchase I have made all year. The amount of insects it captures is WAY better, more cost effective, than anything else."Simply place the tool over a weed, push it into the ground and lean on the long handle to unearth the pesky plant, roots and all, in one fell swoop. Made of powder-coated steel with a real bamboo handle, this tool has vintage charm (it was designed in 1913!) and modern practicality. It uses a simple lever system to grip weeds by the root — just jab it into the ground, tilt and voilà, you're suddenly a backyard hero. Plus, there's something undeniably satisfying about yanking a weed straight from the earth, roots and all — kind of like popping bubble wrap, but more productive.Get your outdoor space ready for spring with this 3-piece furniture set that comes with two rocking chairs and a table, and it's only $70 right now. One recent five-star review said: "It look really good. And easy to put together. The chairs is also strong and comfy. It’s looks really good on my porch and it’s worth the money."Tackle those overgrown shrubs and branches in your yard with ease, thanks to this lightweight (as in, less than 4-lb.) chainsaw. It's conveniently cordless and comes with a rechargeable battery and a bottle of lubricating oil to keep everything running ship-shape. Not yet convinced? I tried an earlier model out for myself and was pleasantly surprised by how ridonculously easy it was to handle.Best Amazon deals: StyleWildly popular leggings for a mere $6? Yes, please! These will get a lot of use in the coming months, thanks to their cropped length that'll keep your legs cool. Plus, the high waist offers support without being too constricting, and according to reviewers, they pass the squat test."I never give five stars," shared a satisfied shopper, "but I am 64 years old, and I have been wearing leggings for about 30 years now. I have never purchased any that were as comfortable as these. I love the feel of the fabric. They are not too tight. They’re snug enough to not be baggy. The fit is incredible and comfortable. After getting my first capri pair, I bought five more."🔥 Great time to buy: These leggings, which have been purchased over 7,000 times this month, are always a steal, but this price — their lowest of the past 90 days — is particularly stellar.Boxers looking worn out? These popular Hanes briefs packs are available in sizes up to 3XL and provide all-day comfort and support. There are 12 in a pack, which works out to just $3.60 per pair - talk about a bargain.These comfy joggers are about to become your new favorite loungewear. They have the seal of approval from writer Chris, who said of these snuggly sweats: "If you open my closet up, you'll see sweats in just about every color of the rainbow, yet I keep going back to this classic gray pair from Hanes. You just can't beat the fit, not too tight, not billowy, just right. Not to mention they're still comfy after more than a few washes. Another thing that they get right? The price."The matching hoodie is on sale as well, for as little as $12.50.Have a spring break vacay on the horizon? The best travel outfits are the ones that feel like pajamas but make us look put together, and this highly rated, casual-chic tank-and-pants duo fits the bill. The latter have a drawstring waist for custom comfort, and the wide-leg design and cropped length help keep things airy in warmer locales. Along with squishy soles, these flip-flops also have arch support to cradle your feet and soft straps for all-day comfort. Comfy, cute flip-flops that cost less than 20 bucks are a veritable steal. And when they're just $10, like this black-and-white option? That's just ridiculous. That said, these flip-flops come in multiple colors — and you won't pay more than $16 for any of 'em."So comfy," wrote one happy customer. "I walked around in these slippers all day on uneven surfaces and normal ground (over 10,000 steps). My feet were extremely comfortable and well supported. These are super flexible and I didn’t have any shoe bites or cuts at all."With a relaxed fit, flattering V-neck and ultra-soft fabric that resists creasing, this ruffled-cap-sleeve dress is your passport to effortless vacation style. Shoppers say you can pull it out of your suitcase, give it a quick shake and be ready to take off. It comes in 28 colors and sizes small to XXL (prices vary). Got summer fashion on the brain? (Us too.) Flowy pants are a warm-weather essential for a reason, so be sure to grab this sleek pair while it's almost 40% off. The drawstring will come in handy after those big summer barbecues, and the easy breezy fabric will keep you cool despite the heat. Shoppers say these are incredibly versatile, stylish and comfortable.Best Amazon deals: HomeBye-bye, soggy bath mats: Yahoo readers are adding this ultra-thick, impossibly soft rug to their carts in droves. It's made of highly absorbent chenille microfiber that'll soak up excess water from your feet in a jiffy, and its plush texture will feel like heaven after your shower. ⏳ Fair price: While this isn't a rare sale (it often hovers around this price), it's within a dollar of its best price on record. Senior Deals Writer Britt Ross actually tested this mat out — check out her full Olanly review for more. Temperatures are starting to rise, and if you're in the market for a chill new appliance, thousands of shoppers swear by this cooling fan. (It was purchased more than 40,000 times this month.) With 90-degree oscillation, it'll cool down the room from many angles, and it has four modes and five speeds for customized comfort.🔥 Great time to buy: I've yet to see it on sale for less, and I anticipate fewer markdowns as the weather gets warmer. My advice? Scoop one up while you can save nearly 30%. Whether you're stowing away shorts and sundresses in the winter or puffer coats and comforters in the summer, these roomy storage bags will keep everything organized from season to season. Each one has an impressive 60-liter capacity, along with see-through front panels so you won't forget what you stashed in them.Check out our full Fab Totes Clothes Storage Bags review for more. This powerful kit is a longtime shopper favorite at Amazon — and now it's more than 40% off. Know this: It might look compact, but it can drive up to 1,500 RPMs of power. The half-inch sleeve means you don't have to worry about it loosening its grip on a screw, either. Its embedded LED bulb helps illuminate low-light areas and, thanks to the included battery, it charges up lickety-split.Plush and oh-so-popular, this blankie feels lighter than air but will also keep you warm on cold nights. It features a box-stitch design to prevent the filling from bunching, and when paired with a luxurious duvet cover, no one will guess that the comforter inside costs just $30.It's also worth calling out that it's Oeko-Tex Standard 100-certified (translation: it was manufactured without certain harmful substances) — which isn't always common with inexpensive bedding.🔥 Great time to buy: Now with 43% off for a limited time only, it's back to the lowest price we've seen so far this year.Related:The best comforters of 2025, tested and reviewedBest Amazon deals: VacuumsYou love your pets, but the shedding? Not so much. Reviewers say that, true to its name, this model's a pro at sucking up their furry friends' hair from surfaces of all types, thanks to its bristled brushroll. But even if you don't count an animal among your housemates, you'll appreciate its lightweight design, strong suction and, at least for the time being, its price tag. Related: The 4 best vacuums for pet hair in 2026, tested and reviewedMore than 30,000 of these powerful handvacs have been purchased in the past month, so you know it's doing something right. Though it only weighs about 2.5 pounds, it has strong suction and impressive battery life, buyers rave. Plus, it comes with crevice and brush attachments.💰 Good deal: Get it while it's down to its best price since December.Having any kind of robovac is great, but you know what's really convenient? One that also functions as a mop, so it can clean every type of floor in your house. Well, such a unicorn exists, and at a truly stellar price: The Lefant checks all the boxes to save you time and space, offering a thorough cleaning experience without needing multiple devices.Think that sounds good? How about the fact that it's also 66% off? Better sweep it up while it's on sale at this deep discount. Best Amazon deals: BeautyNot ready for sandals season just yet? Our Senior Beauty Editor Jennifer Romolini says this handy kit can help! "Just slip on these healing booties packed with exfoliating urea (along with skin conditioning aloe, glycerin and coconut oil) and wait a few hours. Then prepare to witness the softest feet of your life," says Romolini. "Made to work while you sleep, this treatment is especially appealing (no pun!) if your skin is easily irritated, as it's both dermatologist-recommended and, unlike many other dry-foot remedies, exceptionally gentle," she added.Over 50,000 shoppers have purchased this popular face cream in just the past month. Why? This lightweight, non-greasy moisturizer is enriched with collagen to help skin appear firmer, smoother and deeply hydrated over time. As we age, collagen and moisture levels decline, skin loses its bounce and wrinkles form. This moisturizer provides a daily boost of hydration to help the appearance of lines and wrinkles and restore moisture for smoother skin.While it's been reduced to $10, there's a coupon on the page that brings it down to a deal-icious $7. Brightening balms can wake up the sleepiest of eyes. And while Jennifer Aniston may turn to Tatcha's $49 under-eye stick, most of us can't justify the splurge. But don't despair: Jennifer Romolini also named this magic stick one of her top beauty products in September, and for good reason. "It replicates all the wrinkle-smoothing, dark-circle brightening wonders of Tatcha's and — with the addition of de-puffing caffeine — even improves upon the original," she wrote. And it's on sale for just $10 right now.Kojic acid, vitamin C, collagen, retinol, turmeric and more ingredients in this soap help to fade the look of blotches and hyperpigmentation, balance skin's texture, eliminate scarring and minimize the effects of sun damage. Best Amazon deals: KitchenThis twosome is not only adorable, but practical — they nestle together for easy stacking in your cabinet and are made with a DuraSip ceramic lining that provides the look and feel of ceramic mugs with the more, well, durable construction of stainless steel. I purchased this pair as a Valentine's gift for my espresso-loving husband, and we've been enjoying them every morning ever since.Get unstuck with a set of slick pots and pans. This attractive 14-piece collection just about has it all: 8- and 11-inch frying pans, a 4.3-quart casserole with lid, 1.8- and 4.5-quart saucepans with lids, four pan protectors, a spatula and a mixing spoon. That's all for only $70 — less than you'd pay for a single pan from many brands. (The starting price appears to be inflated, but this is still a stellar deal.) Check out our roundup of the best cookware sets for additional options.Groceries are expensive, and overcooking your food is just money down the drain. Take the temperature of your meats, seafood, baked goods and more — doing so helps ensure everything is perfectly (and safely) cooked. This popular gadget (over 10,000 were purchased this month) provides a reading in seconds, so grab one ahead of cookout season.Air fryers are a dime a dozen these days, but this one has several features that set it apart. For starters, it boasts three racks so you can cook your vegetables, proteins and starches at the same time, and its 10-quart capacity holds enough grub for a crowd. Interior lights and a window allow you to keep an eye on your food while it cooks, and there's even a dehydrate function in case you'd like to try your hand at homemade fruit leather or veggie chips. Save nearly 45% while you can. These days, many people are ditching their plastic cutting boards for nontoxic versions. If you're looking to do the same, wood is an excellent alternative, and this set includes not one, not two, but three sturdy boards. Because you're getting a variety of sizes, you'll be able to designate one board for meats, one for produce and another for smaller mincing tasks.Best Amazon deals: TechNever fight with your family members over power outlets again. This electrifying outlet plug-in boasts five AC outlets and four USB ports, enough for everyone to charge their devices at once. Oh, and it's so much sleeker than having a power strip on your floor (and there's no way you'll trip over it). The popular Beats Studio Buds+ are over 40% off right now and are also noise-cancelling, offering up to nine hours of straight listening time (up to 36 hours combined with its charging case) and water- and sweat-resistance. The included interchangeable silicone ear tips will ensure a just-right fit.This is one of those items you hope you'll never have to use — but you'll be grateful for it when your car's battery goes kaput. In addition to giving your vehicle a jump, it'll pump up your tires and acts as a handy on-the-go power station with multiple charging ports. In short? It's an all-around smart item to keep in the trunk.🔥 Great time to buy: Apply the on-page coupon to save over 60% (the best price we've seen so far this year).With a high-definition display, enough ports to connect to nearly any device you can think of and a 16:9 aspect ratio, this baby's on par with most TVs, yet it fits nicely into your laptop bag.Welcome to a new week — honestly, you've earned a little guilt-free shopping haul. ((Getty))If you have Amazon Prime, you'll get free shipping, of course. Not yet a member? No problem. You can sign up for your free 30-day trial here. (And by the way, those without Prime still get free shipping on orders of $35 or more.) The reviews quoted above reflect the most recent versions at the time of publication.
